stance_basis: NFTA is the project applicant and co-preparer of the EIS, having filed the application for Federal capital grant assistance to construct the LRRT system
summary: The Niagara Frontier Transportation Authority (NFTA) is the project applicant and co-preparer of this Draft EIS, having filed an application with UMTA for Federal capital grant assistance to construct a 6.4-mile Light Rail Rapid Transit system along Main Street in Buffalo. NFTA jointly prepared the EIS with UMTA and has been substantially involved in the project's development since at least 1969. As the sponsoring agency, NFTA is unambiguously in favor of the proposed project.
complaint_summary: The NFTA has filed an application with UMTA for Federal capital grant assistance to construct and equip a 6.4-mile Light Rail Rapid Transit System along Main Street in the Buffalo-Amherst Corridor, with a total project cost estimated at $336,250,000 and a requested Federal grant of $269,000,000.
summary_quote: Hence, the Niagara Frontier Transportation Authority proposes an integrated rail/bus transit system comprising a 6.4-mile LRRT line along Main Street between the Buffalo CBD and the SUNYAB's South Campus and a realigned and rescheduled Metrobus system serving as feeder network for the rail transit line

mentions.quote: The Niagara Frontier Transportation Authority of New York (NFTA) has filed an application with UMTA for Federal capital grant assistance to construct and equip a 6.4-mile Light Rail Rapid Transit (LRRT) System along Main Street in the Buffalo-Amherst Corridor, New York.
the NFTA, in July 1976, submitted an application to UMTA (Ref. 28) for a mass transportation capital improvement grant under the Urban Mass Transportation Act of 1964, as amended.

Hence, the Niagara Frontier Transportation Authority proposes an integrated rail/bus transit system comprising a 6.4-mile LRRT line along Main Street between the Buffalo CBD and the SUNYAB's South Campus and a realigned and rescheduled Metrobus system serving as feeder network for the rail transit line
